title: Quiet Enterprise SaaS UI Transformation Review Package
author: Antigravity (Executor)

overview.goal: Rebuild Landing, Admin Command Center, and Demo Storefront according to User Audit & Codex Specifications
overview.summary: Successfully eradicated all AI-template design signals across all 3 web surfaces. Replaced neon glows, gradient text, arbitrary pill badges, and nested cramped cards with an authentic, quiet enterprise SaaS design system (Base #F8FAFC, Ink #0F172A, Brand Indigo #465FFF, Success Teal #10B981). All 24 E2E integration tests remain 100% green.

changes: Slim navbar reduced to 4 primary navigation items: Product, Use cases, Pricing, Resources + 1 primary CTA 'Dùng Thử Workspace'.
Hero rewritten into a single focused value proposition: 'Biến Mọi Tin Nhắn Thành Đơn Hàng' without gradient spam or '2026' badge.
5-step selling storyline implemented: Problem -> Product Proof (1 spacious 1200px visual canvas) -> 4-step Workflow -> Outcomes & Pricing -> Trust & FAQ.
Modular pricing packages added: Starter (390k), Growth (790k), Pro (1.490k), plus single-channel modules for Facebook (250k), Zalo (250k), and E-commerce (490k), with instant VietQR payment modal.
Single consolidated 240px enterprise sidebar with 7 distinct operational views: Inbox, Pipeline, Customers, Catalog, Automations, Staff, Settings.
Removed duplicate navigation tabs and link clutter from the top header; added global search bar (Ctrl+K) and quiet AI engine status tag.
Lowered and compacted the metrics row (~30% height reduction), providing significantly more vertical workspace for active conversations.
3-pane operational inbox layout set to exact proportions: 280px list / flexible thread workspace / 320px Customer 360 & Instant POS drawer.
Refactored takeover button from an aggressive destructive red style to an indigo/ghost operational toggle with emerald active confirmation.
Integrated Customer Directory view, Manual Automation trigger, and Omnichannel connection status hub.
Removed the 'AI 2026' promotional banner and the bulky 'Hướng Dẫn Trải Nghiệm...' instruction block.
Transformed into an authentic, trustworthy boutique apparel storefront ('Fashion Young Studio') with high-craft product showcases.
Added a subtle 5-stage guided progress strip with 3 1-click prompt chips ('Tư vấn size', 'Kiểm kho', 'Chốt đơn') connected to window.openAiChat.
Maintained full compliance with Test 23 assertions (.btn-ask-ai, window.openAiChat).
